items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Oh, the old man Lorenzo Tio, he was from a Spanish place.

ctx.x: The last time I played with Lorenzo. Yeah. In Los Angeles, California. And they gave a party for me. In Los Angeles, California. in Los Angeles, California. They gave a party for me in Los Angeles, California. I forgot the name of the cabaret, wherever it was. And I'm telling you, we had a time that night. That's the time they made me sing Creole song. There were a couple of the Tios, weren't there? Was there a Lorenzo Tio? Lorenzo? Papa Tio. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Do you know where they came from? Oh, the old man…
Were there any of the other old Creole songs that you could remember besides El Abado?
